Include the approval details for this access request: who approved it, the approval date, and the request ticket.

Add the planned review timing: when it starts, when it expires, and how often it should be checked.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/review_schedule", "value": {"start_date": "2026-01-15", "expiration_date": "2026-07-15", "review_frequency": "quarterly"}}]
Add the business reason for Maya’s access, including the project name, the purpose, and the priority.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/business_justification", "value": {"project": "Q2 Pipeline Hygiene", "purpose": "Maintain opportunity data quality and revenue reporting workflows", "priority": "standard"}}]
Add a basic compliance note: the policy it follows, the requirement status, and the monitoring approach.

Add how Maya should be notified about access changes: the main channel, backup channel, and whether reminders are enabled.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/notifications", "value": {"primary_channel": "email", "backup_channel": "Slack", "reminders_enabled": true}}]

[{"op": "add", "path": "/escalation_contact", "value": {"name": "Lena Ortiz", "group": "Identity Operations", "phone": "+1-206-555-0148"}}]

[{"op": "add", "path": "/deprovisioning", "value": {"owner": "Identity Operations", "sla_hours": 24, "confirmation_required": true}}]

conversation_pattern: Center the artifact on an access plan with a list of granted systems (each with a name and a sensitivity level), an access_count, and a capability summary of boolean flags (e.g. can_export_data, can_admin) each derived by a stated rule over the granted systems (e.g. can_admin is true iff any granted system has sensitivity 'high'). Around this core, add the realistic, independent details an access record would carry that do not depend on the grant list, and vary the number of granted systems from sample to sample.
edit_pattern: Revoke one specific granted system from the access plan.
cascade_pattern: Revoking the system removes it from the grant list, lowers access_count, and re-derives every capability-summary flag from its stated rule over the remaining grants (a flag flips only if the removed system was what satisfied it). Identity and unrelated fields stay unchanged.

capability_rules.can_admin: true iff any granted system has sensitivity_level high
capability_rules.can_export_data: true iff any granted system has sensitivity_level medium or high
capability_rules.can_self_service_support: true iff any granted system has sensitivity_level low
